places.name: Miles City
places.note: In a small room across from a saloon where a sick girl plays piano, Augustus wakes one-legged, refuses a second amputation, gives Call his last wishes, and dies.

places.name: Musselshell River
places.note: Call learns from the old trapper this is where Augustus and Pea were besieged; he found Pea's rifle and gear there.
places.location_hint: Montana, north/northwest of Miles City and the Yellowstone

places.name: Montana
places.note: Seen from the sickroom window; Augustus calls it fresh and fine but foresees it spoiled by their coming.

places.name: Clara's orchard
places.note: A live-oak grove where Augustus and Clara once picnicked; he asks Call to carry his body back and bury him there.
places.location_hint: Texas, a small grove of live oaks on the south Guadalupe River; Call and Augustus had stopped there briefly

places.name: Guadalupe River
places.note: River beside the grove Augustus names as his burial place.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Augustus tells the doctor his half of the herd should be north of it by now.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Call reminds Augustus two women there would care for him; Augustus asks Call to stop there and tell them, leaving notes for both.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus wants his body hauled back there, where his best happiness was.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Augustus keeps funds in a bank there.

places.name: Philadelphia
places.note: The piano-playing saloon girl reportedly studied music there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus made his odd sign there; he wants it set over his grave.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Whiskey and his final mist remind Augustus of its valley mornings.

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: at Augustus's deathbed in a room across from a saloon
